0.1.7.en: Clear No limit and Unlocked status displays; retain diagnostic fallback states and existing Flow tags and device settings. Prepare the community CCM15 listing and generic pairing setup.

0.1.8.en: Allow up to 30 seconds for delayed gateway state confirmation, while sending each command only once.

0.1.9.en: Confirm power Off when swing stops with the indoor, while preserving its command parameter. Refuse enabling swing on an Off indoor and prevent Fan Off requests from silently becoming Auto.

0.1.10.en: Confirm power Off when an indoor reports its fan stopped, while retaining strict running-state checks and preserving command parameters. Improve inactive limit and restriction status, local Flow controls, delayed confirmation and device pairing.

0.1.11.en: Find CCM15 gateways on the local network, import configured indoor names, and show gateway information. Existing device names and Flows are preserved.

0.1.12.en: Fix pairing navigation after selecting a gateway. Show a clear completion message when all indoor units are already added, preserve Homey view globals, and allow returning to gateway selection.

0.1.13.en: Update the App Store name to Midea, add a public support contact and replace the app cover with official Midea lifestyle photography. CCM15 support and device controls are unchanged.
